name: Sue Lines Pursuant to the order agreed to yesterday, the time allotted for debate on this bill has expired. I will now put the questions before the chair and then put the questions on the remaining stages of the bill. I will deal first with the second reading amendments, starting with the amendment moved by Senator Payman and also on behalf of Senators David Pocock, Lambie, Thorpe and Tyrrell. Nick McKim On behalf of the Australian Greens, I request that part (a) be put separately to part (b). I confirm that we will be voting differently on those two parts. Sue Lines The question is that the amendment on sheet 3612 be agreed to. The Greens have requested the amendment be split. We are dealing with part (a).
